P1: Roblox renamed 46 yielding methods to *Async (Jan 14, 2026): Player:LoadCharacter -> LoadCharacterAsync; BadgeService:AwardBadge -> AwardBadgeAsync; MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo -> GetProductInfoAsync. NOT renamed: Instance:WaitForChild and RemoteFunction:InvokeServer (also InvokeClient, BindableFunction:Invoke) keep their names. The old names still work; they are flagged deprecated informationally with no removal scheduled. Use the Async names in new code.
P2: Opt in with Workspace.AuthorityMode = Server (full release July 9, 2026). It forces: NextGenerationReplication on, PlayerScriptsUseInputActionSystem on, SignalBehavior = Deferred, StreamingEnabled on, UseFixedSimulation on. Client-predicted, simulation-affecting logic goes in RunService:BindToSimulation(fn): it runs on both client and server and can be re-run during resimulation/rollback, so it must be deterministic. Use time() as the clock (tick(), os.time(), os.clock() are local and don't roll back). Read input via InputAction (not UserInputService); don't Destroy/reparent/EquipTool inside bound functions. Put rendering, sound, VFX in RenderStepped and tolerate mispredictions. Custom predicted state uses attributes (max 64, names/strings <= 50 chars). SetNetworkOwner is not a substitute.

Timeline: Phase 1 June 2026 (IAS full release June 11) - default disabled, opt in; Phase 2 early 2027 (planned) - default enabled; Phase 3 mid 2027 (planned) - property removed, legacy scripts gone (dates may slip). G1: Rules: only one script may set MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt (second silently replaces first). Look up the player by PlayerId; if absent or product unknown return NotProcessedYet. Make it idempotent on receiptInfo.PurchaseId: store processed PurchaseIds in the same profile document as the grant (UpdateAsync/session-locked profile) so grant + marker save atomically. Return PurchaseGranted ONLY after the grant has been successfully saved; on any failure (pcall error) return NotProcessedYet so Roblox retries. Never grant in PromptProductPurchaseFinished. Charged but nothing: callback returned Granted before save (or save failed / server crashed) so Roblox never re-delivers; or handler errored/yielded forever; or another script overwrote the callback. Double grant: no PurchaseId check, so a retry (after NotProcessedYet, timeout, or rejoin to another server) grants again, or receipts kept in a separate store from the profile.
G2: Use UpdateAsync whenever the new value depends on the old one or multiple servers can write the key (player data, counters, session locks); never GetAsync+SetAsync (race overwrites). SetAsync only for blind overwrites of data nobody else writes. Transform rules: function(old, keyInfo) returns (newValue, userIds, metadata) - pass keyInfo:GetUserIds()/GetMetadata() or they're cleared; must not yield (no task.wait, *Async, remote invokes); may run multiple times on conflict, so be pure: no side effects (grants, remotes) and don't mutate live tables, copy; return nil to cancel the write; handle old == nil properly (only new player if the call actually succeeded). Wrap in pcall; UpdateAsync costs 1 read + 1 write.
G3:
Not safe. typeof(gold)=='number' passes NaN (NaN < 0 and NaN > x are both false), inf is caught but fractional values (0.5) and -0 slip through; 0 also creates spam offers. Also it doesn't reserve/escrow the gold: the player can make many offers or spend the gold afterwards (double spend), and there's no rate limit or check that a trade session exists. Fix:
```lua
offerRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, gold)
  if typeof(gold) ~= "number" or gold ~= gold or gold % 1 ~= 0 then return end
  if gold <= 0 or gold > 1e9 then return end
  if not rateLimit(player) or not activeTrade[player] then return end
  if gold > player.Gold.Value then return end
  player.Gold.Value -= gold          -- escrow server-side
  createOffer(player, gold)           -- refund on cancel
end)
```
Re-validate balances at trade completion (atomically).
G4: The Animator steps all playing tracks each frame (after PreAnimation, before PreSimulation) and overwrites Motor6D.Transform on joints it animates, so a Heartbeat write is replaced before physics/rendering uses it (Heartbeat runs after simulation). Write procedural offsets to motor.Transform in RunService.PreSimulation (after animation, before physics), e.g. motor.Transform = motor.Transform * CFrame.Angles(pitch,yaw,0) to layer on the animation, or replace it. Clamp dt for smoothing; since the turret is server-owned, server writes are fine. Edit C0 instead for a fixed/rarely changing rest or mount offset: the Animator never writes C0 so it persists, but it is never cleaned up, replicates as a property change (costly every frame) and fights retargeting.
G5: Blending is per joint: a track only competes on joints it keys. AnimationPriority order (Core < Idle < Movement < Action < Action2/3/4); the highest-priority playing track on a joint gets its weight first. If its weight is 1 it takes the joint fully and lower tracks are ignored; if weight < 1 the remainder goes to lower priorities. Tracks at the same priority are blended (weights summed and normalised), not chosen. Walk is Movement priority; if your swing is also Movement/Core or plays with weight < 1 (or fades in), it gets mixed with or overridden by walk, looking weak. Fix: set the swing's Priority to Action (set before Play, or on the asset), play with weight 1 (track:Play(fadeTime, 1)/AdjustWeight), and make sure it keys the arm joints.
G6: Unit mismatch: FBX stores centimetres while Blender works in metres, and Studio's importer interprets the file's unit scale, so the scale chain (Blender scene units -> FBX 'Apply Scalings' -> importer) yields ~100x. Fix at export, not in Studio. Recommended: keep 1 Blender unit = 1 stud (or set Unit Scale 0.01 for meter scenes), FBX export Apply Scalings = 'FBX Units Scale', Forward -Z/Z Forward, Up Y, Apply Unit on, Apply Transform, Path Mode Copy + Embed Textures, Add Leaf Bones off, Only Deform Bones on, Bake Animation with Key All Bones, NLA/All Actions off for single clips, simplify 0. In the 3D Importer check the scale/unit setting (Studs). Don't rescale animated rigs in Studio (breaks clip translations).
G7: Modifiers are non-destructive in Blender; Roblox imports only the base mesh data. The glTF exporter's 'Apply Modifiers' option (Include/Data > Mesh) is off by default, so Mirror (only one half modeled) and Bevel never get baked. Catch: applying modifiers at export doesn't work with shape keys (meshes with shape keys export without modifiers applied / you lose morphs), and for rigged/skinned meshes modifier order vs Armature matters, so they're often applied manually; applying also destroys the editable source. Workflow: keep a Source collection, apply on a duplicate (or enable the exporter option for static meshes), and ensure Mirror has Clipping/Merge with origin on the symmetry plane; fix normals/shading after Bevel.
G8: 1) fromScale(0.3,0.3) is 30% of width and 30% of height, so on different aspect ratios a square becomes a rectangle. Fix: add UIAspectRatioConstraint (AspectRatio = 1) or SizeConstraint = RelativeYY, and/or UIScale; use Offset/UISizeConstraint for min/max. 2) The button sits under the notch/top bar because the ScreenGui ignores insets. Fix: ScreenGui.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInsets (avoids notch and Roblox top bar) with ClipToDeviceSafeArea = true and SafeAreaCompatibility = None (IgnoreGuiInset is legacy). Read GuiService.TopbarInset live instead of hard-coding 36/58. Put full-screen backgrounds in a separate ScreenGui with ScreenInsets = None.

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Items = require(RS.ItemCatalog) -- server-trusted prices
local last = {}
RS.BuyItem.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemId, quantity)
  if typeof(itemId) ~= "string" or typeof(quantity) ~= "number" then return end
  if quantity ~= quantity or quantity % 1 ~= 0 or quantity < 1 or quantity > 99 then return end
  local item = Items[itemId]; if not item then return end
  local now = os.clock()
  if last[player] and now - last[player] < 0.25 then return end
  last[player] = now
  local data = PlayerData.get(player); if not data then return end
  local cost = item.Price * quantity
  if data.Coins < cost then return end
  data.Coins -= cost                    -- deduct and grant in same step, no yield
  data.Inventory[itemId] = (data.Inventory[itemId] or 0) + quantity
  PlayerData.markDirty(player)
end)
game.Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) last[p] = nil end)
```
Never trust client price/balance; server owns data.

-- profile key: "player_"..userId ; value = {data=..., lock={jobId, sessionToken, expires}}
local LEASE = 90
function load(player)
  local token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
  for i=1,5 do
    local ok, res = pcall(store.UpdateAsync, store, key(player), function(v)
      v = v or {data = defaults(), lock = nil}
      if v.lock and v.lock.token ~= token and v.lock.expires > os.time() then return nil end -- locked elsewhere
      v.lock = {jobId = game.JobId, token = token, expires = os.time() + LEASE}
      return v
    end)
    if ok and res and res.lock.token == token then return res.data, token end
    task.wait(2^i)
  end
  player:Kick("Data busy, rejoin") -- never play on defaults
end
function save(player, release) -- autosave every ~30-120s (< LEASE/3), release on leave/teleport
  store:UpdateAsync(key(player), function(v)
    if not v or not v.lock or v.lock.token ~= session[player].token then return nil end -- lost lock: stop writing
    v.data = session[player].data
    v.lock = (not release) and {jobId=game.JobId, token=v.lock.token, expires=os.time()+LEASE} or nil
    return v
  end)
end
```

In Studio solo play the player can join before the server Script runs and connects PlayerAdded (scripts are loaded/required with yields first), so the event already fired and your handler never runs for that player. Standard fix: put the setup in a function, connect it, then loop existing players:
```lua
local function onPlayerAdded(player) --[[create leaderstats]] end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, p) end
```
